# Tokyo Trip Guide

> > Your comprehensive guide to Tokyo travel: attractions, hotels, dining, etiquette, and practical transportation advice for exploring Japan's capital.

Tokyo Trip Guide provides curated recommendations for visitors to Tokyo, covering everything from luxury accommodations like Park Hyatt Tokyo and Aman Tokyo to cultural experiences at Meiji Jingu and Tokyo Tower. The site offers practical travel advice on transportation passes, airport transfers, etiquette, and budget-friendly activities across Tokyo's diverse neighborhoods including Shinjuku, Harajuku, Akihabara, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo attractions and landmarks
- Luxury hotels and ryokan accommodations
- Japanese etiquette and customs
- Transportation passes (JR Pass, Tokyo Metro)
- Airport transfers (Narita, Haneda)
- Budget travel and free activities
- Theme parks (Tokyo DisneySea, Fuji-Q Highland)
- Kawaii culture and Harajuku fashion
- Mount Fuji day trips
- Shinjuku, Otemachi, and Akihabara districts
- Business hotels and five-star properties
- Electronics shopping in Akihabara
- Traditional shrines and temples
- Maid cafés and otaku culture

- [Tokyo Airport Transportation: Cheapest vs. Fastest Options](https://tripguide.tokyo/tokyo-airport-transport-cheapest-fastest): Narita & Haneda airport transport: cheapest vs fastest options compared
